chapters.title: Launch
chapters.text: 48 agents share one board; 2 control agents work alone. The broker enforces a search boundary (ADR-0042) and a 48 h deadline.

chapters.title: Spreading out
chapters.text: Atlases, Sobol sweeps, CMA-ES runs and symmetry-resolved families start in parallel: about 40 hypotheses in the first half hour.

chapters.title: First signal
chapters.text: swarm-au finds the S2×T1∥ joint orbit at amplitude 0.3 (5059, R = 1.39). swarm-t's cross-family Gaussian process lifts it to 3.03 (4a76).

chapters.title: The relay
chapters.text: swarm-ap takes 4a76 and runs constrained gradient ascent over 31 symmetry-allowed joint orbits: 4.39 at 2.4 h, past the first campaign's best.

chapters.title: Climbing the caps
chapters.text: Each round fills the Σ|α| and Σ|β| caps further: 6.66 → 7.09 → 8.86. swarm-ab runs matched-density controls along the way.

chapters.title: 077d
chapters.text: swarm-ap's final step at both caps gives 077d: R = 10.53 on 4×6, 26× the uniform LLL. Most of the board turns to verifying it.

chapters.title: Refining at the boundary
chapters.text: swarm-af probes 077d's neighbourhood and finds 5eda at exactly the caps: R = 10.76. The 5×6 GPU queue paces the remaining claims.

chapters.title: Done
chapters.text: The agents finish near the deadline. Best w3 result: 10.76× the static parent (27× the uniform LLL), on the search boundary.
